title: Support Ticket completion certification OpenAPI precision migration

phases.objective: Upgrade only the known completion-certification legacy OpenAPI operation with canonical runtime metadata while preserving its request and response schemas and rejecting every non-allowlisted imprecise operation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the precise contract registry writer against a root OpenAPI document containing the known legacy completion-certification operation
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact operation gains canonical runtime provenance and authorization metadata without losing its existing schemas, the resulting document is idempotent, and an unrelated imprecise operation remains blocked.
steps: Create a synthetic root OpenAPI document with the exact legacy completion-certification operation and its existing request and response details.
Discover the matching runtime route and exact admin/backend authorization profile.
Apply the allowlisted metadata upgrade through the precise contract registry writer.
Read the written OpenAPI document and verify preserved schemas plus canonical runtime metadata.
Run check mode for idempotence and submit a structurally similar non-allowlisted operation to prove fail-closed behavior.
assertions: Only POST /admin/support/tickets/{ticket_id}/external-delivery/completion-certification is eligible for the metadata-only legacy migration.
The operation ID, security alternatives, consequential classification, parameters, request body, responses, and descriptions are preserved or reasserted exactly.
Canonical x-runtime-contract-source and x-runtime-auth-profile metadata are present after composition.
A second check reports no generated drift.
Any non-allowlisted imprecise Support Ticket operation fails with support_ticket_existing_contract_not_precise.

phases.objective: Remove the one-time legacy allowlist after the generated root OpenAPI contract is merged and no supported branch requires migration.
Extend contract provenance drift detection without permitting generic metadata-only upgrades.
This repository-only OpenAPI metadata migration has no external canary target.
Production deployment and runtime verification remain outside this repository-only contract migration.
